title: Gang Leader Look
eyebrow: The Bank Robbery music video · her look · round 2
heading: Who leads the balaclava gang?
intro: Kai, 17 Nov: the voice is a bratty young woman MC, so the gang gets a seventh member: its leader, small, unarmed, no suit, with the six big men behind her like bodyguards. Each design is drawn into the real shot of the gang walking out of the exploding bank. Every row shows take a and take b, each as Flow drew it and after a pass that shrinks her to the men's chest height (some were already small, so pick whichever size reads best). Pick in any row you like and leave a note; the one you like most, note it 'this one'. Mask colours are placeholders and can change.

sections.lede: Each design differs in outline, not just colour. Click any picture to see it large; arrows step through the row.

groups.title: A. The Bandit Queen (jet-black balaclava)
groups.line: Black velvet riding outfit, long skirt, plumed Stetson. Pointing at the lens.

groups.title: B. The Borrowed Duster (mint-green balaclava)
groups.line: Rose prairie dress under a man's duster far too big for her. Shouting through cupped hands.

groups.title: C. The Ghost in the Dust (powder-blue balaclava)
groups.line: Pale duster belted over a beaded dress. Telling the camera off with one finger.

groups.title: D. The Rodeo Queen (turquoise balaclava)
groups.line: Fringed suede rodeo jacket, riding skirt, tall boots. One arm flung up.

groups.title: E. The Flapper Outlaw (tangerine balaclava)
groups.line: Beaded fringe flapper dress, empty gunbelt, cowboy boots, oversized Stetson. Shrugging.
